theme_and_archetype.rationale: High energy, command-center feel tailored for a single active trader needing precise, fast data.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: 12-column CSS Grid. Use col-span-3 or col-span-4 for metric cards, col-span-full for data tables.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_rules: Prioritize density. Tight gaps (gap-4) for widgets. Generous padding only in empty states.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Right-align all financial numbers/metrics. Left-align text. Center-align status badges.

surface_strategies.cards_and_widgets: Flat solid background (#141414). 1px subtle inner stroke (border-white/10). No soft shadows. Sharp or slightly rounded edges (max 4px).
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 with 1px border-white/10 on the bottom.
surface_strategies.inputs_and_forms: Solid dark background, 1px border, stark white text, strong focus ring (ring-2 ring-[#007AFF]).

components.data_tables: Sticky headers, frozen leftmost column. Row hover states (bg-[#1F1F1F]). High density (py-2 or py-3).
components.strategy_cards: Top status badge, internal metrics grid, strict alignment. 1px border default, bright border on hover.
components.approval_center: Prominent countdown timers using Monospace font. Red text when <10s. Large, high-contrast Approve/Reject buttons.
components.calendar_pl: Grid layout. Cells colored conditionally based on daily profit/loss (Tinted green vs tinted red backgrounds with clear text).
components.tag_chips: Small, uppercase, color-coded based on tag type. Text size xs.

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-[2px]) on cards, border color brightens.
motion.micro_interactions: Pulse effect on pending approval countdowns when < 10 seconds.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Sharp, technical, duotone or bold depending on emphasis. Provide installation command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

images.description: Vivid dark abstract geometric shapes - Use for login background or empty state hero.
Stock market graph - Use for placeholder visuals in analysis empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use Tailwind default blue/green, use the exact hex codes via arbitrary values or tailwind config.
Prioritize data density. Do not use excessive padding in tables or lists.
Use Shadcn UI components (.js files) but strip away the soft 'Vercel' look. Make them sharp, dark, and tactical.
For the Strategy Manager and Trade Journal, use complex responsive grids.
Ensure the countdown timer in the Approval Center uses JetBrains Mono or a similar tabular figures font to avoid jittering.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions; use Shadcn.
Remember to load the specified Google Fonts (Barlow Condensed, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono) in the document head or via CSS imports.
